attestations.text: WANG Ching-ch'i 汪景祺 (T. 無己, H. 星堂), 1672–1726, Jan. 15, victim of a literary inquisition, was a native of Ch'ien-t'ang (Hangchow), Chekiang. His personal name was originally Jih-ch'i 日祺.
